description: This file is the main entry point for a Vue.js frontend application. It imports styling, creates the app instance, registers plugins (Pinia for state management and router for navigation), and mounts the app to a DOM element.

methods.name: createApp
methods.description: Initializes a new Vue application with the root component.

methods.name: createPinia
methods.description: Creates a new Pinia store instance for state management.

methods.name: app.use
methods.description: Registers plugins (Pinia, router) to the Vue app.

methods.name: app.mount
methods.description: Mounts the Vue app to a DOM element with id 'app'.
